title: TutorialCore: First Steps
summary: Set up the first safe TutorialCore loop before widening the route.

blocks.title: Start Small
blocks.body: Read new cards when they unlock, but treat them as route coaching rather than chores. Useful help often appears after a concrete action or mistake.

blocks.title: First Clean Win
blocks.body: A first TutorialCore win is reading a card when it appears and using it to choose the next small action instead of treating it as homework.

blocks.title: Before You Expand
blocks.body: Name the goal, the exit, and the resource or signal that proves TutorialCore is helping. If any of those are vague, keep the next run shorter.

blocks.title: Ready Check
blocks.body: Before moving on, confirm the first setup step is repeatable and safe enough to do again.
